_about: Data of the old_basement set (old house basement at night (iron furnace, wooden stairs, pipes, crates)), light preset warmInterior. Made by tools/new_set.py from the indoor base. Read by tools/build_props.py (marks, front), src/world/sets/OldBasement.tsx (room), tools/set_review.py (review). Marks = feet positions (m). The room is closed (4 walls); the cameras sit inside it, usually on the +z side looking to -z.

lights.furnace: furnace fire glow (0 = cold, 1 = burning; default 1)
lights.bulb: bare hanging bulb (0 = off, 1 = on; default 1)
lights.door: light through the door crack at the top of the stairs (0 = dark, 1 = lit; default 1)

_camera_bounds: box the camera must stay inside (walls, ceiling); presets shorten their distance to fit

review._about: tools/set_review.py: sun = the locked warmInterior key light, shadow_size = its locked box; the sweep's center/radius; points = the room's top corners (add big furniture)

_marks_note: landing: Lena at the front of the landing, 0.4 m clear of the ajar door's leaf (it swings into the room up to z -1.9). Marks must stay clear of moving parts (BUILDING.md).
